name: diag_t02_cache_first5_black_guard_01
command:
"""One-off exact first5 cache black-gate retry proof; run_logged only."""
import io
import json
import shlex
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
from src.tools import phase_watch as watch
from src.tools import t02_cache_check as cache
ROOT = Path.cwd().resolve()
NAME, JOB = 't02_export_cache_first5_01', '709024.hopper-m-02'
ACCOUNT = 'diag_pbs_usage_709024_final'
DIRECTORY = ROOT / 'logs/pbs/t02_export_cache_first5_01-20261109T182259Z-2027fd05'
auditor = watch.load_module('cache_retry_original_auditor', ROOT / 'scripts/audit_provenance.py')
def require(value, message):
    if not value: raise ValueError(message)
def load(name):
    return watch.load_logged(ROOT, ROOT / 'results' / (name + '.json'), auditor)
def ref(path):
    return {'file': str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': watch.digest(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size}
outer, outer_ref = load(NAME)
gate, gate_ref = load(NAME + '_gate')
account, account_ref = load(ACCOUNT)
payload_path = DIRECTORY / 'payload.json'
payload = json.loads(payload_path.read_text())
receipt = json.loads((DIRECTORY / 'submission.json').read_text())
require(account['_meta']['command'] == ['python3','src/tools/pbs_usage.py','--name',ACCOUNT,JOB]
        and account['_meta']['exit_code'] == 0 and account['metrics']['complete_allocation_accounting'] is True
        and account['config']['errors'] == [], 'Canonical final allocation accounting is incomplete')
require(json.dumps(account['config'], indent=2) in (ROOT / account['_meta']['log_path']).read_text(), 'Canonical config not in authenticated log')
entries = [row for row in account['config']['jobs'] if row['job_id'] == JOB]
require(len(entries) == 1 and entries[0]['qstat_exit'] == 0, 'Canonical job missing or ambiguous')
f = entries[0]['fields']
require(f['Job_Owner'].split('@')[0] == 'e1583364' and f['run_count'] == '1', 'Wrong owned original job')
require(payload['repo'] == str(ROOT) and payload['name'] == NAME and payload['task_id'] == 'T01'
        and payload['budget_group'] == 'T02' and payload['queue'] == 'autox'
        and payload['requested_gpu_count'] == 1 and payload['requested_host'] is None
        and payload['requested_wall_seconds'] == 1230 and payload['dry_run'] is False,
        'Not the exact approved unpinned cache allocation')
require(receipt['returncode'] == 0 and receipt['stdout'].strip() == JOB and not receipt['stderr'], 'Original submission receipt mismatch')
script = DIRECTORY / 'job.pbs'
require(payload_path.stat().st_mode & 0o222 == 0 and script.stat().st_mode & 0o222 == 0, 'Original allocation files not immutable')
template = (ROOT / 'scripts/pbs/job_1gpu.pbs').read_text()
require(template.count('@@CVPR_PAYLOAD@@') == 1 and script.read_text() == template.replace('@@CVPR_PAYLOAD@@', shlex.quote(str(payload_path))), 'Original one-GPU PBS template mismatch')
qsub = ['qsub','-N',f['Job_Name'],'-l','walltime=00:20:30','-o',str(DIRECTORY/'pbs.out'),str(script)]
require(receipt['command'] == qsub and shlex.split(f['Submit_arguments']) == qsub[1:]
        and f['Output_Path'].split(':',1)[1] == str(DIRECTORY/'pbs.out')
        and f['Resource_List.walltime'] == '00:20:30' and f['Resource_List.ngpus'] == '1'
        and f['Resource_List.ncpus'] == '12' and f['queue'] == 'smallx'
        and 'PBS_O_QUEUE=autox' in f['Variable_List']
        and float(f['Resource_List.queue_charge_rate']) == payload['requested_queue_charge_rate'], 'Actual PBS resources/command/charge mismatch')
source_names = [f'results/t02_export_first6_01_retry2_u{i:04d}.json' for i in (0,1,2,4,5)]
expected = ['python3','-u','-m','src.tools.t02_cache_check','--name',NAME]
for source in source_names: expected += ['--source',source]
expected += ['--sample-size','200','--seed','0','--timeout-seconds','1200','--pair-timeout-seconds','180','--gate-timeout-seconds','180']
require(payload['command'] == expected and outer['_meta']['command'] == expected, 'Cache plan or submitted command changed')
c,m = outer['config'],outer['metrics']
require(c['version'] == cache.VERSION and c['policy'] == cache.CACHE_POLICY and c['source'] == source_names
        and c['sample_size'] == 200 and c['seed'] == 0 and c['gpus'] == 1 and c['resolution'] == 255
        and c['timeout_seconds'] == 1200 and c['pair_timeout_seconds'] == 180 and c['gate_timeout_seconds'] == 180
        and c['max_raw_mib'] == 2048 and c['pbs_jobid'] == JOB and c['name'] == NAME,
        'Recorded cache policy/source/population parameters changed')
require(m['kind'] == 't02_formal_cache_check' and m['status'] == 'blocked_by_render_gate'
        and m['producer_exit_code'] == 86 and m['black_frame_detected'] is True
        and m['worker_runs'] == [] and m['population_ledger'] == [] and m['sampling_plan'] is None
        and m['validation_report'] is None and m['cache_matches_live'] is None
        and m['downstream_allowed'] is False and m['stop_downstream'] is True
        and m['errors'] == [] and m['cleanup_errors'] == [], 'Not a clean pre-sampling native black stop')
require(all(m['gate'].get(k) == gate_ref.get(k) for k in ('file','sha256','metrics_sha256','git_commit')), 'Exact original gate reference mismatch')
reason = watch.validate_black_retry(payload, JOB, f, outer, gate, NAME+'_gate', 't02_formal_cache_check')
g,a,gm = gate['config'],gate['config']['allocation'],gate['metrics']
require(g['name'] == NAME+'_gate' and g['resolution'] == 255 and g['segmentation'] is True and g['timeout_seconds'] == 180
        and g['node'] == c['node'] == outer['_meta']['host'] == gate['_meta']['host']
        and a['cuda_visible_devices'] == c['cuda_visible_devices']
        and a['cuda_driver_uuids'] == [c['cuda_visible_devices']]
        and a['cpu_affinity'] == c['cpu_affinity'] and len(set(c['cpu_affinity'])) == len(c['cpu_affinity']) == 12
        and a['scratch'] == payload['environment']['CVPR_SCRATCH'], 'Native gate mask/CPU/scratch/producer mismatch')
argv = gate['_meta']['command']
require(Path(argv[0]).name == 'python3' and argv[1:-1] == ['-u','-m','src.tools.render_gate','--name',NAME+'_gate','--gpus','1','--resolution','255','--segmentation','--timeout-seconds'] and argv[-1] in ('180','180.0'), 'Exact gate producer command mismatch')
obs = gm['devices'][0]['observation']
require([r['stage'] for r in obs['captures']] == ['after_constructor','after_Pass']
        and any(p['stage'] == 'Pass' and p['fresh_main_rgb_payloads'] > 0 and p['cached_metadata'] is False for p in obs['wire_packets']), 'Missing actual fresh constructor/Pass proof')
images = []
for capture in obs['captures']:
    require(capture['shape'] == [255,255,3] and capture['dtype'] == 'uint8' and capture['black'] is True
            and capture['nonzero_rgb_values'] == capture['min_rgb'] == capture['max_rgb'] == 0 and not capture['error_message'], 'Not actual full-zero RGB')
    p = Path(capture['png']['path']).resolve()
    require(p.parent == ROOT/'logs/runs'/(NAME+'_gate')/'render_gate' and watch.digest(p) == capture['png']['sha256'], 'Native PNG original bytes mismatch')
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(p.read_bytes())) as image:
        require(image.mode == 'RGB' and image.size == (255,255) and image.getextrema() == ((0,0),)*3, 'Decoded original PNG is not all zero')
    images.append(ref(p))
for p in (ROOT/'logs/pbs').glob('*/payload.json'):
    require(json.loads(p.read_text()).get('retry_of') != JOB, 'Retry already submitted; do not duplicate')
print('BLACK_RETRY_GUARD_JSON: '+json.dumps({'eligible_proven_black_gate_retry': True,'reason':reason,
    'job_id':JOB,'name':NAME,'node':c['node'],'gpu_uuid':c['cuda_visible_devices'],
    'original_payload':ref(payload_path),'original_receipt':ref(DIRECTORY/'submission.json'),
    'source_results':[outer_ref,gate_ref],'pbs_accounting':account_ref,'captures':images,
    'fixed_export_sources':source_names,'sample_size':200,'seed':0,'cleanup_errors':[],
    'permission_scope':'fresh run name with retry_of exact old job; identical fixed cache population/plan parameters; no submission performed here'},sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
